questions.stem: I am fed up with students like Tom.

options.B: I'll model myself on students like Tom.

questions.explain:

something that you have experienced for too long 厭倦的；厭煩的；失望的
e.g. I'm fed up with my job. 我厭倦了我的工作。(2) be v. fond of + n.: to like
someone or something very much; to like doing something 喜愛…；喜歡
做… e.g. He was very fond of Legos. 他非常喜歡樂高積木。(3) model
yourself on somebody: to try to make yourself very similar to someone else
仿效（某人）；模仿（某人） e.g. Lots of young singers modelled
themselves on Lady Gaga.很多年輕歌手都以Lady Gaga為仿效對象。(4) be
v. disgusted with + n.: feeling extreme dislike or disapproval of something 反
感的，厭惡的，憎惡的 e.g. I'm totally disgusted with his behavior. 我非常討
厭他的行為。

questions.stem: You can see a lot of workers at the construction _____.
questions.explain:
construction site: 建築工地
scene: 現場、場景
sight: 景象、視力
解析：題意為「你可以在工地上看到許多工人」。英語中「工地」固定為 construction site，故答案選D。選項A（scene，多指案發現場）、B（seat，座位）語意不合；C（sight，景觀）與 site 發音相同，為同音異義字的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: We wish the bride and the groom _____.

questions.stem: Much _____ my surprise, he came back from the war safe and sound.
questions.explain:
to one's surprise: 令某人驚訝的是
safe and sound: 安然無恙
解析：題意為「令我大為驚訝的是，他從戰場安然無恙歸來」。表示「令某人感到...」的固定句型為「to one's + 情緒名詞」，前可加 much 強調，故答案選C。選項 A、B、D 均非固定搭配，其中 with 易受中文「帶著驚訝」字面直譯陷阱誤導，需特別注意。

questions.stem: The Internet has already had a strong impact on the way people live and work.
questions.explain: impact = effect = influence影響

questions.stem: At the present time a new road _____ in that part of the city.
questions.explain:
at (the) present time 當下的時間，用現在式或是現在進行式，因路是被建造
的，用被動態，所以選項要選C(is being built 正在被建造中)。

questions.stem: My grandparents live ___ 243 Park Road.
questions.explain:
at: 在（特定門牌地址）
on: 在...街道上
along: 沿著
解析：題意為祖父母住在公園路243號。英文提及具體門牌號碼時，介系詞須用at，故答案選B。主要干擾選項C的on僅用於不帶門牌的單純街名；A（沿著）與D（在...上方）皆不符合居住地址的文法。

questions.stem: Fish and meat go _____ easily if they are not properly stored.
questions.explain:
go bad: to become spoiled; no longer be fresh enough to eat or drink e.g.
The meat has gone bad.

questions.stem: You have to admit that your girlfriend is very particular about what she wears and eats.
questions.explain: particular=special特定的，具體的; choosy挑剔的; generous慷慨的，大方的

questions.stem: By the time we meet, winter _____.
questions.explain:
這題的重點是[ By the time ]的句型： (1) [ By the time ]是連接詞，假如它引
導的子句是描述未來，主要子句要用未來完成式。例句如下： a) By the time
they are released, they will have learned some skills to begin their new lives.
b) By the time Dad comes home, I will have finished my homework. 雖然[ By
the time ]引導的子句是描述未來，但其動詞要用現在式。 (2) [ By the time ]
引導的子句也可以描述過去，主要子句要用過去完成式。例句如下： a) By
the time I finished my homework, my young brother had gone to bed. b) By
the time I got to Maggie's place, she and her friends had all waited for me.
(3) 除[ By the time ]的句型外，還有另一類似句型： [ By + 未來時間, 主詞 +
未來完成式 … ] 例句如下： a) By the year 2050, the world will have lacked
for enough food. b) By this time next year, this company will have sold
billions of smart phones.

questions.stem: Stop smoking in here, _____?
questions.explain:
第二人稱[you]引導的肯定祈使句，其附加問句通常要用[will you]， - [ Let's =
Let us ]引導的肯定祈使句，其附加問句要用[shall we]。 - [ Let ]引導的肯定祈
使句，所接的代名詞不是[us]時，其附加問句要用[will you]。 - [ Let ]引導的否
定祈使句，其附加問句要用[O.K.] 或 [all right] 。

questions.stem: To attract more customers, the supermarket is giving away free _____ to makeup.
questions.explain: samples of makeup 化妝品樣本

questions.stem: You are welcome to use all the _____ in our hotel.
questions.explain:
facilities: the buildings, equipment, and services provided for a particular
purpose

questions.stem: I don't want those old-fashioned cameras. I want a _____ one.
questions.explain:
old-fashioned: 老式的、過時的
digital: 數位的
physical: 實體的、身體的
logical: 合乎邏輯的
解析：句意為「我不要那些老式相機，我想要一台數位的」。空格需與 old-fashioned 成對比，修飾相機應搭配 digital camera，故答案選C。干擾項 physical、logical 與 gentle 均為形容詞且字尾讀音類似，但語意分別為實體、邏輯與溫和，完全不符合題意。

questions.stem: Major Babbit won't come in today because he is _____ sick leave.
questions.explain:
on sick leave 請病假 definition of sick leave (1) an absence from work
permitted because of illness (2) the number of days per year for which an
employer agrees to pay employees who are sick

questions.stem: The small town is _____ a holiday resort.
questions.explain:
Resort 渡假勝地；旅遊勝地; be known as 是「以某身分出名」, 「作為…而
知名」 ； be known for 是「以某特點、長處出名」 ；be known to 是「對某
人來說是出名的」; be known by 「從…區分」

questions.stem: It looks like you are playing a _____ game. Why not give up?
questions.explain:
根據句子上下文的意思 答案選 c 句譯:看來是一場沒有勝利希望的比賽。您為
什麼不放棄？ A losing game: A failing or hopeless effort; a situation or
activity that is ultimately futile or cannot be won. 沒有勝利希望的比賽, 徒勞
之舉 Give up: to stop owning and using something放棄（某物的所有權或使
用權）

questions.stem: It was not your fault. I'm to _____.
questions.explain: I'm to blame. 我才是要怪罪的人

questions.stem: You _____ be more careful when making an investment.
questions.explain:
句譯: 您進行投資時會更加小心。
"Couldn't be more" is a phrase you can use to express that it is not possible
to be or have more of something.
Make an investment: Investment (n.) the act of putting money, effort, time,
etc. into something to make a profit or get an advantage, or the money,
effort, time, etc. used to do this投資
e.g. There's been a significant investment of time and energy in order to
make the project a success.
為了這個專案計劃的成功，已經投入了大量的時間和精力。

questions.stem: I think I'll take it because the price is _____.
questions.explain:
reasonable price e.g. This product is not only of the highest quality but also
very reasonably priced.

questions.stem: We could see the Stars and Stripes flying _____ the American Embassy.
questions.explain: 星星和條紋(指美國國旗)在美國領事館上方飛揚

questions.stem: Three days after the major surgery, Tom was still too feeble to get out of bed.
questions.explain: feeble= weak 衰弱

questions.stem: More and more people _____ health conscious in recent years.
questions.explain:
凡句中有in recent years/months (最近幾年/幾個月) 的時間副詞片語出現時,
常與現在完成式或現在完成進行式並用; 表示到現在為止仍在繼續的動作或狀
態時, 使用現在完成式來表達; 表示一直持續到現在且可能仍將繼續下去的動
作時, 則使用現在完成進行式來表達。

questions.stem: Much as I _____ those victims, I'm not able to help them.
questions.explain:
much as = although; victim 受害者; sympathize 同情 ; come across偶遇;
clear up 放晴, 大掃除

questions.stem: Can you imagine _____ to such a selfish man?
questions.explain:
imagine(想像) 之用法： (1) Imagine [ + (that) ]: e.g. Imagine (that) you're
eating ice cream - try to feel how cold it is. 設想你在吃霜淇淋—試著感受一
下它有多麼冷。 (2) Imagine + [ + question word ]: e.g. Can you imagine how
it feels to be blind? 你能想像失明的感覺嗎？ (3) Imagine + [ + -ing verb ]
e.g. She imagined herself sitting in her favorite chair back home. 她想像自己
正坐在家中最喜歡的扶手椅上。 此題要選 D: be.v. married to + 人 或是
marry +人 代表結婚的英文用法 ，因句子後有介係詞 to，所以be.v. 要改為動
名詞 being。

questions.stem: My younger brother was sleeping _____ when I entered his room.
questions.explain: sleep like a log= sleep very well 睡得很香

questions.stem: Currently, health care costs _____ about 12% of the gross domestic product.
questions.explain:
account for表示｢解釋、說明｣、｢對...負有責任｣、｢佔...比例｣
1. 說明, 作某事物的解釋, 解釋某事物的原因
He could not account for his foolish mistake. 他無法解釋他所犯的荒謬的錯
誤。
2. 對...負有責任
Who will have to account for the misprints in the dictionary? 誰必須對字典中
的印刷錯誤負責?
3. Students account for the vast majority of our customers.
學生佔我們的顧客比例絕大部分。

questions.stem: The fire broke out in the afternoon and was not _____ until midnight.
questions.explain:
put out: to make something such as a fire or cigarette stop burning 撲滅
（火）；熄滅（香煙） e.g. Firefighters have been called to put out the fire
in the city center. 已經叫了消防員來撲滅市中心的火。

questions.stem: He was _____ in heavy traffic for about an hour.
questions.explain:
be caught in: stuck in e.g. I'm sorry I'm late. I was caught in traffic. Our taxi
was stuck in traffic and I thought I would never get to the airport on time.

questions.stem: Mary and I are considering _____ scuba diving next weekend.
questions.explain:
consider + doing 考慮做... e.g. He is considering going to study abroad. 他正
考慮出國留學。

questions.stem: My dad often _____ while watching TV.
questions.explain: Fall asleep 睡著了 drop out 退出 check in報到 go abroad 出國

questions.stem: Sergeant, it's time you _____ to Captain Smith.
questions.explain:
It's time you + 過去式動詞 We can use the expression it's time + subject +
past verb form to refer to the present moment: e.g. Gosh! It's almost
midnight. It's time we went home. Note: It's time we go home. 但是要在 It's
time ... 的後面接子句的話, 要注意這個子句會用過去簡單式 比如要說: It's
time (that) you grew up. (你該長大了) 而不是 It's time (that) you grow up. 在
這種句型裡其實是一種和現在事實相反的假設 因為這樣講通常是指對方現在
其實沒有這麼做 所以和 if 的句型一樣, 和現在事實相反的假設用過去式表達
It's time ... 也可以用 It's about time ... 或 It's high time ... (早該是...的時候了)
例如: It's about time (that) he told the truth. It's high time (that) the
government took care of this problem.

questions.stem: A tank is a good vehicle for military use because of its ability to travel over different types of terrain. For strategic reasons, however, tanks are often disguised to hide from the enemy. What strategy is often used with regard to tanks?
questions.explain:
根據句子的意思得知坦克通常使用偽裝 句譯: 坦克由於具有在不同類型的地形
上行駛的能力而成為軍事用途的良好交通工具。但是，出於戰略原因，坦克
經常被偽裝，對敵人隱藏。坦克通常使用什麼策略？ disguise (v.): to give a
new appearance to a person or thing, especially in order to hide its true form
將…偽裝起來 e.g. We tried to disguise the fact that it was just a school hall
by putting up colored lights and balloons. 我們掛上彩燈和氣球，不想讓人看
出這裡實際上只是一個學校禮堂。 Camouflage (n.) the use of leaves,
branches, paints, and clothes for hiding soldiers or military equipment so
that they cannot be seen against their surroundings（軍事）掩護，隱蔽，偽
裝 e.g. Using smoke as (a) camouflage, the army advanced up the hill. 軍隊
利用煙霧作掩護向山上挺進。

questions.stem: The word “blog” is short for a biographical web log. A blog is a record of what someone does or thinks each day, which he or she puts on a web page. The web page usually contains his or her personal opinions, comments or experiences. What is a blog?
questions.explain:
根據文中blog說明,它是日誌一種 句譯: “博客”一詞是傳記網頁日誌的縮寫。博
客記錄了某人每天在網頁上的行為或想法。 該網頁通常包含他或她的個人意
見，評論或經驗。

questions.stem: In a modern city there are hostile microbes everywhere. Almost every day we are exposed to the sufficiency of them to bring us down with some sort of infection. Which of the following is closest in meaning to “microbes”?
questions.explain:
與microbes意思接近的字是 bacteria 句譯: 在現代城市中，到處都有不好的微
生物。幾乎每天我們都有接觸，且數量多到足以使我們遭受某種程度的感
染。

questions.stem: A powerful undersea earthquake unleashed a tsunami that hit the western Solomon Islands yesterday, destroying entire villages and killing an estimated 15 people. What did the earthquake cause?
questions.explain:
根據句子的意思得知海底地震造成許多傷害 句譯: 一場強烈的海底地震引發了
海嘯，昨天海嘯襲擊了所羅門群島⻄部，摧毀了整個村莊，並造成約15人喪
生。

questions.stem: There are three branches of medicine. Although “scientific medicine” is the mainstream, many people would often turn to “folk medicine” or “faith healing” for help, especially when they or their family members are terminally ill. Quite a few people believe in _____.
questions.explain:
句譯: 醫學分為三個分支。儘管“科學醫療”是主流，但許多人經常會求助於“⺠
間醫療”或“信仰療法”，尤其是當他們或家人患絕症時。相當多人相信另類療
法。
